name: Alameda de la Sagra (Spain)
description: Red field with narrow blue stripes along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Alameda de la Sagra (a hammer, a crescent and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Alameda de la Sagra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alameda de la Sagra arms — hammer on yellow, crescent and waves
